advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 22.59; 2/2 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 2/4 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Trail-brake understeer: finish more braking before steering; caster +0.5 for camber-in-turn.
advice.evidence: 1/4 corners red on the fronts at turn-in
